data.name: Vanora Climate
data.description: Vanora Climate is a small, early-stage climate company that appears to be based in Bengaluru, India. A team member's LinkedIn profile says it is scaling carbon removal through biochar and regenerative agriculture. Apart from LinkedIn, there is almost no public information about it: no website, registry listing or press coverage turned up.
